then.text: A giant containment tube filled with swirling green digital essence. Fragments of viral meme content pulse inside. Labels on the base read: 'SPECIMEN: CONCENTRATED MEME ENERGY — DO NOT RELEASE'.

else.text: Through the anaglyph distortion I can barely make out... a giant tube? Something green pulses inside. My eyes hurt just looking at it.

then.text: I touch the glass. It's warm. The liquid inside reacts, swirling faster. A readout spikes: 'VIRALITY INDEX: CRITICAL'. Better not disturb it.

else.text: I reach toward the blurry shape. If only I could see clearly through this optical nightmare...

TALK.text: I press my ear to the tube. From inside I hear whispers: '...to the moon... wagmi... gm...' The memes are alive.

PICK.text: It's bolted to the floor and ceiling. This thing isn't going anywhere. Neither are the memes trapped inside.

PUSH.text: I push against the tube. It doesn't budge, but the liquid inside sloshes aggressively. The memes are agitated.

then.text: The screen reads 'MEME VIRUS 99%'. Progress bar nearly full. Below: 'DEPLOYMENT STATUS: PENDING'. Someone was engineering weaponized memes here.
Log entries scroll: 'MEME_PROPAGATION_RATE: EXPONENTIAL. ESTIMATED_VIRALITY: INFINITE. TARGET: ALL TIMELINES'. This is... terrifying and hilarious.

else.text: I squint through the red-blue haze. Numbers flicker on a screen... 99%... something. Can't read the rest.

then.text: I try the keyboard. Dead. But the screen flickers: 'LAST OPERATOR: Dr. S. — EXPERIMENT STATUS: CONTAINED'. Dr. Satoshi was running this lab.

else.text: I mash keys I can barely see. The screen responds with garbled colors. Useless without clear vision.

TALK.text: I address the screen directly. 'What are you deploying?' No response. Screens don't talk back. Unlike memes.

then.text: A board labeled 'RARITY INDEX' with charts and emoji faces ranked by rarity. It's like a periodic table of memes.
The hierarchy: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary... and above all, circled in red: 'ULTRA RARE PEPE'. Someone took meme economics very seriously.

else.text: A board with... charts? Faces? Everything is doubled and shifted. The anaglyph makes it impossible to read.

USE.text: I trace the rarity tiers with my finger. Each level has a corresponding 'market cap' estimate. They were pricing memes like crypto tokens.

PICK.text: The board is screwed to the wall. Probably for the best — this kind of research shouldn't leave the lab.

then.text: Beakers filled with glowing green liquid. Labels read: 'CONCENTRATED VIRALITY', 'DISTILLED SARCASM', 'PURE IRONY'. This is a meme chemistry lab.

else.text: Blurry glass shapes. Something green. Could be chemistry equipment, could be modern art. Hard to tell in anaglyph.

USE.text: I'm not drinking that. The last person who did probably became a full-time shitposter on crypto Twitter.

PICK.text: These chemicals should stay right where they are. In a secure, undrinkable location.

OPEN.text: I uncork a beaker. The smell hits me like a trending tweet — sharp, viral, and impossible to ignore. I cork it back immediately.

then.text: A big red button with 'DO NOT PUSH' written above it in multiple languages. Classic. The most tempting button in any lab.

else.text: Something red. A button? The label is unreadable through the distortion but I can feel it daring me.

then.text: I already pushed it once. The tube is still glowing brighter. I should probably stop pressing mysterious buttons in secret meme labs.

else.text: I push the button. The containment tube surges with light. Every screen in the room flashes 'FEELS GOOD MAN' for exactly 4.20 seconds.
Then silence. The tube settles back to its normal glow. Whatever I just did... I'm sure it was fine.

then.text: No. Once was enough. I can still see 'FEELS GOOD MAN' burned into my retinas.

then.text: Green slime drips from the ceiling. It smells like digital decay — like if an NFT could decompose. The slime pulses in rhythm with the containment tube.

else.text: Something drips from above. Green? Red? Blue? All of the above? This anaglyph is giving me a headache.

USE.text: I'd rather not touch the slime. It's probably sentient by now. And it might have opinions about yield farming.

PICK.text: I am NOT picking up radioactive meme slime. I have standards. Low standards, but standards.

LOOK.text: It's a rare Pepe printout, wearing 3D glasses just like mine! It sits on the desk, perfectly preserved. The rarest of rare. The meme to end all memes.

then.text: I already have the rare Pepe. One is enough. The meme market can't handle more supply.

else.text: I carefully pick up the rare Pepe. It feels... warm? Like holding pure meme energy. The eyes seem to follow me.
A label on the back reads: 'SPECIMEN #001 — THE ORIGINAL. Do not expose to normies. Handle with diamond hands.'

USE.text: I stare into the Pepe's eyes. It stares back. We share a moment of mutual understanding. Feels good, man.

TALK.text: 'Hello, Pepe.' The frog says nothing. But somehow I feel... validated. Like getting 1000 likes on a tweet that took 2 seconds to write.

LOOK.text: The door back to the Liquidity Pool. Somehow it looks more inviting from this side.

then.text: A rack of analysis equipment: oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, and something labeled 'MEME RESONANCE DETECTOR'. All monitoring the containment tube's output.

else.text: Boxy shapes with blinking lights. Equipment of some kind. The anaglyph makes everything look like abstract art.

USE.text: I flip a switch. A readout displays: 'CURRENT MEME SENTIMENT: BULLISH'. I flip it back.

OPEN.text: I open a panel. Inside: a tangle of wires and a sticky note that reads 'IF MEMES ESCAPE, RUN.' Reassuring.

The entire room is stuck in some kind of anaglyph 3D mode. Like a bad '80s movie.

If only I had something to help me see through this optical chaos...
